title: James McDonald at the Australian schoolyard landing

tellings.quote: And then you can actually see in the big case where the UFOs lands in the schoolyard in Australia, he's actually there. He's interviewing people at that and he actually mentions the fact he's working on a presidential study.

plain: In 1966 a UFO is said to have landed in a schoolyard in Australia, and a scientist named James McDonald, who looked into UFO reports, is said to have gone there himself and interviewed the witnesses. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this without naming a source. He adds that McDonald told people there he was working on a presidential study, which would mean the White House had someone looking into UFOs.
